description:
You are a bone morphologist studying cranial bone microarchitecture using CT imaging. The CT Cranium DICOM series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. Output files should go into /home/ga/Documents/cancellous_study/ (directory already created).

Your goal is to isolate the cancellous (trabecular/spongy) bone compartment, which lies between the inner and outer cortical surfaces, using boolean mask operations:
1. Create a compact bone mask covering only dense cortical bone (Hounsfield range approximately 662–1988 HU)
2. Create a full bone mask covering all bone tissue (Hounsfield range approximately 226–3071 HU)
3. Apply the boolean subtraction operation (full bone MINUS compact bone) to produce a new mask representing only the cancellous bone interior
4. Generate a 3D surface from the cancellous bone mask
5. Export the cancellous bone surface as an STL file to /home/ga/Documents/cancellous_study/cancellous_bone.stl
6. Save the complete project (with all three masks: compact bone, full bone, and cancellous bone result) to /home/ga/Documents/cancellous_study/bone_analysis.inv3
